scale: Each score is the net pregame advantage for the HOME team on that aspect, from -1 (clearly favours the away team) through 0 (neutral or balanced) to +1 (clearly favours the home team). Score 0 with evidence_present=false when the supplied pregame evidence says nothing about the aspect.

candidates.name: star_availability
candidates.description: Availability of each team's most important players (injuries, rest, suspensions, minutes limits) as stated before the cutoff.

candidates.name: rotation_depth
candidates.description: Availability and quality of bench and rotation players beyond the stars; replacement depth for absences.

candidates.name: lineup_continuity
candidates.description: Stability of starting lineups and rotations; recent lineup changes or new combinations.

candidates.name: returning_players
candidates.description: Players returning from absence (possible rust, minutes restrictions or a lift) on either side.

candidates.name: recent_form
candidates.description: Recent results and performance trend over the last several games, beyond what season averages show.

candidates.name: momentum_sentiment
candidates.description: Tone and confidence of the pregame notes: streaks, narratives, morale or turmoil as described by the publishers.

candidates.name: offensive_matchup
candidates.description: Home offense against away defense versus away offense against home defense: scoring efficiency and shot quality edges.

candidates.name: defensive_matchup
candidates.description: Defensive strengths that target the opponent's main threats (rim protection, perimeter defense, scheme fit).

candidates.name: pace_style
candidates.description: Which team's preferred tempo and style is more likely to prevail in this matchup.

candidates.name: rebounding_edge
candidates.description: Offensive and defensive rebounding advantage and second-chance opportunities.

candidates.name: turnover_edge
candidates.description: Ball security and forcing turnovers; live-ball turnover and transition advantages.

candidates.name: three_point_profile
candidates.description: Three-point volume and accuracy edge, including reliance on high-variance shooting.

candidates.name: rest_advantage
candidates.description: Days of rest and back-to-back situations for each team.

candidates.name: travel_fatigue
candidates.description: Road-trip length, time-zone changes and travel load before this game.

candidates.name: schedule_congestion
candidates.description: Games in recent nights and upcoming schedule pressure beyond simple rest days.

candidates.name: head_to_head
candidates.description: Season series and recent meetings between these teams, including stated matchup history.

candidates.name: home_court_strength
candidates.description: Home team's home record and away team's road record relative to their overall quality.

candidates.name: motivation_stakes
candidates.description: Playoff race, seeding, tanking, rivalry, milestones or other stated motivation differences.

candidates.name: coaching_tactics
candidates.description: Coaching changes, stated tactical adjustments, or coaching matchup factors.

candidates.name: availability_uncertainty
candidates.description: Unresolved questionable or probable statuses; positive when the home team's availability picture is more certain or favourable than the away team's.

candidates.name: clutch_close_games
candidates.description: Performance in close games and late-game execution as documented before the game.

candidates.name: free_throw_edge
candidates.description: Free-throw rate and accuracy advantage; foul drawing and foul trouble tendencies.

candidates.name: roster_changes
candidates.description: Recent trades, signings, call-ups or departures that change team strength.

candidates.name: experience_composure
candidates.description: Experience, youth and composure factors explicitly raised by the notes.

selection.note: Pilot default chosen before any teacher output. Re-select with bam_concepts.py select from TRAIN concept labels (decisive frequency) before any DEV use; the teacher labels every candidate so re-selection needs no new teacher calls.
